title: pm-dispatch: a metadata project's cards, decisions included, live in its own repo; only platform problems are filed on objectstack/objectui
body:
Fixes #17288

## 裁决 — the maintainer's words, verbatim and untranslated (PM chat session, 2026-09-10T03:2xZ)

「hotcrm 所有的卡本来就应该在 hotcrm，包括其他元数据项目。除非元数据项目发现平台由问题，给平台立卡片。现在就是这么 操作的」

Reading (binding, as the card carries it): a metadata project's cards — work cards AND decision cards — live in that project's own repo (hotcrm and every other metadata project); the only cards a metadata project files on the platform are the platform problems it finds, filed as ordinary platform cards on objectstack / objectui. That is already the practice (hotcrm carries the full state-label set including `needs-user-decision` and holds open decision cards today); the rule text was what disagreed, in three 〈多仓协调〉 rows, their core-rules digest twin, and the hotcrm charter.

## Every rewritten line, before / after, beside the ruling clause it implements

Net-zero lines in all three files; every rewritten line sits under the ratchet's 120-byte width rule (measured widths in brackets).

**1. `SKILL.md` 〈多仓协调〉, the 单车道仓 row** — implements 「hotcrm 所有的卡本来就应该在 hotcrm，包括其他元数据项目」 (a single-lane repo's decision cards live in that repo's own inbox; nothing defaults to objectstack).

- before [111 B]: 「单车道仓 `repo:*` 席自理机械三务,⛔ 不产 `domain:*`;决策卡默认入 objectstack 收件箱。」
- after [117 B]: 「单车道仓 `repo:*` 席自理机械三务,⛔ 不产 `domain:*`;决策卡入本仓收件箱,不落 objectstack。」
- The first two clauses are byte-identical; only the third changed.

**2. `SKILL.md` 〈多仓协调〉, the 收件箱 row under 规则 1** — implements the same clause read from the inbox side (the maintainer's inbox is per repo: objectstack and objectui for platform decisions, each metadata project for its own).

- before [71 B]: 「维护者收件箱恒为 objectstack;在飞卡 ⛔ 不中途转仓。」
- after [114 B]: 「决策收件箱按仓:平台在 objectstack / objectui,元数据项目在本仓;在飞卡 ⛔ 不中途转仓。」
- 「在飞卡 ⛔ 不中途转仓」 kept verbatim. The row now uses the same term as the director charter's cross-repo duty (「决策收件箱 `needs-user-decision` 跨仓勤务」), which was checked and left unchanged — it already reads every repo's inbox.

**3. `SKILL.md` 〈多仓协调〉, the 目标仓不可达 row under 规则 5** — implements 「现在就是这么 操作的」 together with 「除非元数据项目发现平台由问题，给平台立卡片」: an unreachable target repo is a reading gap, not a home; a card that belongs in another repo is filed there by a seat that can reach it, and the seam rule (规则 1 的缝卡三行, untouched) stays for genuine coordination cards only.

- before [84 B]: 「目标仓不可达时按缝卡规则落 objectstack 带 `repo:*` + 具名读者。」
- after [119 B]: 「目标仓不可达是读数缺口,不是落点:由可达席在目标仓立卡,此前请求记座位贴或协调卡。」

**4. `references/core-rules.md` 〈多仓协调〉 digest, the line carrying 「在飞卡 ⛔ 不中途转仓」** — the twin (SKILL.md 优先级 rule: 「一条规则在本文与核心条款一处改动,另一处同 PR 同改」) of rows 1 and 2.

- before [90 B]: 「跨仓查重与 shadow 检查恒归中央 ⛔ 不下放,在飞卡 ⛔ 不中途转仓。」
- after [118 B]: 「跨仓查重与 shadow 检查恒归中央 ⛔ 不下放;决策卡入本仓收件箱,在飞卡 ⛔ 不中途转仓。」
- Why this line and not the two the dispatch named (the 单车道 line and the 缝卡 line): those sit at 119 B and 116 B of the 120-byte width rule with the file at its 151-line ceiling, so neither can take a clause without deleting text of a rule that did NOT change (their SKILL.md twins — the first two clauses of row 1, and the seam-card rows — are byte-identical in this PR). The digest line that already holds row 2's other clause is the true twin slot and had 30 B of headroom. Row 3 has no digest twin today (the digest never mentioned unreachability) and none is added: under the width rule it would cost a clause of an unchanged rule. Measured, declared here and in the report.

**5. `references/lanes/hotcrm.md` 〈范围〉, the last row** — the mirror sentence: hotcrm's own cards, decisions included, live in hotcrm. Folded into the row that already said the work-card half (「纯 hotcrm 修复住 hotcrm 仓」), so the platform-gap exception row (「建设 hotcrm 时发现的平台能力缺口,立普通平台卡到 objectstack 或 objectui」 — the ruling's 「除非…给平台立卡片」, already the practice) and the seam-label row (「`repo:hotcrm` 缝标签只给真协调卡」) stay byte-identical, as the card asks.

- before [67 B]: 「纯 hotcrm 修复住 hotcrm 仓:issue 住在修复落地的仓。」
- after [111 B]: 「hotcrm 自己的卡(含决策卡)都住 hotcrm 仓:issue 住在修复落地的仓,决策入本仓收件箱。」

Untouched by construction (md5 measured before and after): the decision frame block (`22f2339f0acb64cdb50c7adc9db681c3`), the lane table, every tier row, the state table's `needs-user-decision` row (「维护者的收件箱」 is generic and stays). No issue numbers, no model names, no ruling dates in any skill file — the date lives here.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

### 改了什么

把 PM 技能里三条「卡片住哪个仓」的规则改成你说的做法:元数据项目(hotcrm 等)自己的卡,包括要你拍板的决策卡,住它自己的仓;平台的决策卡住 objectstack / objectui;元数据项目只有发现平台问题时才在平台仓立普通卡。顺带把核心条款摘要和 hotcrm 车道说明改成同一句话。三个文件行数不变,只改了五行文字。

### 为什么改

规则原文写的是「决策卡默认入 objectstack 收件箱」「维护者收件箱恒为 objectstack」「目标仓不可达就落 objectstack」——和你 9 月 10 日说的「hotcrm 所有的卡本来就应该在 hotcrm」正好相反,也和实际做法相反(hotcrm 仓今天就挂着 `needs-user-decision` 的卡)。规则和做法打架,下一个按规则行事的席位就会把 hotcrm 的决策卡立错仓。

### 风险与代价(含回滚)

- 只改规则文本,不动任何代码、不发布任何包,没有 changeset。
- 已经放错仓的存量卡(objectstack 里带 `repo:hotcrm` 的六张、决策箱里问同一件事的 objectui 那张)不在本 PR 里动,归分诊或各仓席位另行搬迁。
- 回滚就是 revert 这一个提交;五行改回原文,行数与门禁都不变。

### 席位意见

(留空)

### 你要做的

一个动作:人工合并本 PR(`.claude/**` 是受管面,只能你来合)。

## Acceptance notes

- **Governed terminal.** `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --test SKILL.md core-rules.md lanes/hotcrm.md` → exit 3, verdict line: 「governed-surface predicate: 3 of 3 path(s) hit the register (5 surfaces, repo-agnostic). ⛔ GOVERNED — a human merge is the review record for this PR」. Draft PR; never ready / enqueue / auto-merge / approve by any seat.
- **Changeset: none owed.** Nothing in `.claude/**` ships in any package's `files[]`; the PM applies `skip-changeset`.
- **Gates, verdict lines quoted (all run on commit 28dd4580 in the worktree, exit captured before any pipe):**
  - `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` → exit 0 — 「.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md is 812 lines (ceiling 812; headroom 0)」「references/core-rules.md is 151 lines (ceiling 151; headroom 0)」「references/lanes/hotcrm.md is 53 lines (ceiling 53; headroom 0)」; no line over the 120-byte budget.
  - `pnpm check:skill-frame-sync` → exit 0 — 「2 copies of the decision frame are structurally isomorphic across 2 files … 76 markdown files scanned for undeclared copies」.
  - `pnpm check:skill-compatibility` → exit 0 — 「11 SKILL.md file(s) reconciled against 80 workspace packages … 11 pinned major(s) all match」.
  - `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` → exit 0 — 「27 file(s) clean (pattern /#[0-9]{3,}/g)」.
  - `pnpm check:pm-governed-prose` → exit 0 — 「2 instruction surface(s) name all 5 registered governed surfaces … and claim no others」.
  - `pnpm check:nul-bytes` → exit 0 — 「OK (scanned 8150 text file(s) … no raw ASCII control bytes)」.
  - `pnpm check:pm-governed-merges` → exit 0 (self-test 274 assertions; live generator certified this tree).
  - Whole-tree families the derivation names on every card: `check:agent-test-spelling`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:driver-memory-census`, `check:refd-timer-probe`, `check:watch-hint-literal`, `node scripts/check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs` (+ `--self-test`), `node scripts/check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs`, `node scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test` → all exit 0.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` → exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET on the fresh worktree (`@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` unbuilt); built both under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` (VERDICT command-exit 0, lock held 169s, waited 0s) and reran → exit 0 — 「✓ check:doc-formula-expressions: 14 predicate(s) on a statically determinable field layer judged clean; 6 skipped as undeterminable」.
  - Derivation: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (no paths; the script took the changeset itself — 3 committed paths vs merge base 8c9bd8f5) = 16 families, identical to the path-based preview; `--ran` reconciliation: 「16 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 16 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED」, one extra beyond the union (`check:skill-compatibility`).
- **Ratchet arithmetic.** SKILL.md 812 → 812 (3 lines rewritten in place); core-rules.md 151 → 151 (1 line); lanes/hotcrm.md 53 → 53 (1 line). Widths 111→117, 71→114, 84→119, 90→118, 67→111 bytes, all ≤ 120. No ceiling touched.
- **Assumptions A–E, measured.** A: ceilings 812 / 151 / 53 all at headroom 0 — confirmed, hence in-place rewrites and the hotcrm mirror folded into an existing row; the 120-byte width rule is the second constraint the PM's candidate wordings did not clear (they measured 128 / 123 / 121 / 136 B), so each was tightened. B: same-day churn `c47edbb2`, `d03c3c96`, `8efe2753` confirmed on `git log`; the rows sat at :191 / :210 / :235 on `8c9bd8f5` — re-measured after fetch, unchanged. C: `check:pm-governed-prose` and `check:skill-compatibility` both green above (the prose gate reads governed-surface code spans, not these rows). D: no card numbers in any skill file; the relocation of the existing `repo:hotcrm` / `repo:objectui` cards is not in this diff. E: the state table's `needs-user-decision` row stays byte-identical.
- **Deviations from the dispatch's line plan (measured, not preference).** (i) The core-rules twin lands on the digest line carrying 「在飞卡 ⛔ 不中途转仓」 rather than on the 单车道 / 缝卡 lines — width rule, see item 4. (ii) The hotcrm mirror sentence is folded into the 「纯 hotcrm 修复住 hotcrm 仓」 row rather than into the exception row or the seam-label row, which the card asks to keep — both stay byte-identical. (iii) The unreachable-target row's wording carries 「此前请求记座位贴或协调卡」 as the ruling reading gave it; a coordination card is a record, the seat post an accelerator — consistent with the 规则 5 row above it.
- **Not this PR, remains open.** #17250 is evidence only and is not decided here; the six `repo:hotcrm` cards in objectstack and the 22 `repo:objectui` cards are relocation acts for triage / the repo seats. #17311 (parallel) owns `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`, `scripts/check-*`, `skills/**`, `packages/**` and the docs page — none touched here.
- **Out of scope, noted, not filed** (bearer: none): none found.
